answer: Entry is auctioned, not given away. Twelve slots open each epoch. Newcomers bid in quartz credits, each a gram of quartz; a 400-credit bid costs real work. Top twelve enter; losers pay 5 credits. Bids are inked in sable in public. A farmer wanting a hundred identities must win a hundred auctions, spending 40,000 credits, while one earns a few hundred per epoch. Honest agents pay once and keep full earnings; a pulse of auctions keeps prices fair.
